notes.title: Lilith Rising - Season 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/b2e70eb8c533265df267ec2079fc5d1a0c4be211.png[/img]

Hi friends,

This is quick update, from our Game Director:

Hi everyone, first I personally and the entire team truly appreciate your support in our game, your feedback is invaluable for us, to make the game better for everyone to enjoy.

On to Season 2 Update:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864850/Lilith_Rising__Season_2/]The Steam page is live, and we officially started the marketing campaign for season 2![/url]

Season 2 is planned for release on Q3 of 2024, so hopefully we can release before September.

We’ve hired a team of Rendering Artists (4), a Programmer, and a 2D Artist, in addition to the Composer, Community Manager, Marketing and our Game Director (Jubei). So we’re now a team of 10!

Production is faster and better than ever!

Season 2 will have at least 2x (twice) more content than Season 1. It will have 8 episodes, each will have a unique adventure, an opportunity for a date, and romance with one of the girls.

We’re now estimating about 6-8 hours of gameplay, but until we finish production and actually test the game with beta testers it’s only a guesstimate.

If you wish to help out, you can send our new Steam page to your friends, and post anywhere so they will wishlist season 2 - on steam, this helps a-lot.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864850/Lilith_Rising__Season_2/]Wishlist here[/url]

Thank you so much for your continuous support.

Jubei

Game Director
Jubei Games.

notes.title: Welcome
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/e23de8349d8ce4311de7948c2ae0710936d78591.jpg[/img]

Hi, welcome to my page!
I thank you from all my heart! 

I'm Jubei and I create Adult Visual Novels as a professional. 
I worked in the games industry for more then 15+ years, on many games, now I finally decided to take the plunge and create my own game. 
It's a story that was burning inside of me, literally clawing its way out wanting to be told. As a Manga and Anime connoisseur from a young age (maybe you noticed my nickname as a dead give-away), I believe a real story has no bounds, not verbally or physically, people are people and telling a story while hiding their deepest desires just limits the story. So sex, violence and adult themes were a must for me, here I can tell the stories raw - as they should really be told! 

I want to thank you again for reading this far and hopefully supporting us in our adventure together to bring this story to fruition.

Please Wishlist our game on steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424440]Link: Lilith Rising - Season One[/url]

[h2]Lilith Rising - Synopsis[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/96db31dfbdf6cfa33abf2a0e9406c253635f2776.png[/img]

Lilith Rising is a fantasy adult Visual Novel (VN) where you play as a privileged prince that has his life turned upside down caught as a pawn in the whims of gods and demons, forcing him out of his comfortable life. On your adventures, you will meet the most intriguing companions and learn what it means to be a leader, in order to save your kingdom; and if you play your cards right maybe even find some romance. A fun fantasy adventure, filled with humor, drama, epic battles, mystery and lots of sex!

[h2]Companions[/h2]
[h3]Freja[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/cc32dc2d9c722cbe35c0cc390a998e56ab2aebc5.png[/img]
Freja is a feisty woman that wields a two-handed sword to fight. She has a strong personality, a strong moral compass, and a strong body to carry it all, but she’s a bit unaware of social expectations and good manners.

[h3]Valery[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/a6d5eae3f06921330dd6cbfe637717ff9acc1a49.png[/img]
Valery is the captain of the royal scouts and she uses her bow to strike down her enemies. She’s the sneaky type and believes that the mission is the highest priority, even if you need to bend the rules to get there. She puts on a tough façade, but deep down you can see that she truly cares about others.

[h3]Ishi[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/accdf16e556945205472a359bf63b35551fcd893.png[/img]
Ishi is a traveler from a faraway land to the east. She’s a skilled martial artist, who prefers up-close and personal hand-to-hand combat. She is very spiritual, and believes you shouldn’t mess with the flow of destiny and has a determined, vibrant personality although she’s a bit serious at times.

[h3]Gwen[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/6a0264d22ca546995269fa326320388e5c866b03.png[/img]
Gwen is your betrothed, the princess of another house. You grew up together from a young age and became the best of friends, but each of you went on your own path in the past few years. Gwen is a young vibrant woman, bursting with energy, as clever and sharp as her sword.

[h3]Sophie and Sylvie[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/4201b8274b0f962bfa9be06f45559bf55d93922e.png[/img]
These two sisters are a classic “two sides of the same coin”. Sophie is fiery, energetic and adventurous, while Sylvie is icy, timid and introverted. These two do everything together! Everything!

[h2]The Team[/h2]
We are a team full of amazing creators that have been in the game industry for many years and worked on many amazing games. Our dream is to deliver to you a memorable experience and make you completely immersed in the fantasy world of the game. Tainted is a game set in a fantasy world with a rich story for you to experience. You’ll have an intriguing and dramatic story, meaningful choices and plenty of sex scenes. If you enjoy well-crafted characters and spicy scenes, we’re sure you’ll enjoy our game!


Thank you so much!
